messages.title: [DEMO] End-Semester Practical Examination Schedule 2026
messages.content: All FE students are informed that the SPPU Phase-II Practical Examination schedule has been released on the college portal. Please verify your batch slots and report with completed laboratory journals.

messages.title: [DEMO] Final Year Major Project Review-II Announcement
messages.content: BE Computer Engineering project teams must submit their mid-term progress reports by Friday 17:00 IST. The evaluation committee will assess GitHub commit history, architecture diagrams, and hardware integration status.

messages.title: [DEMO] Google Cloud Study Jam 2026 & AI Workshop
messages.content: We are kicking off the Annual GDSC Cloud Study Jam! Hands-on labs covering Vertex AI, Cloud Run, and Gemini API integration. Registered participants will receive complimentary skill badges and credits.

messages.title: [DEMO] [RESTRICTED] Solar Water Heater Maintenance & Inspection
messages.content: Maintenance of the A-Wing and B-Wing solar heating system will be conducted tomorrow between 10:00 AM and 01:00 PM. Hot water supply will resume normal operation by 2:00 PM.

messages.title: [DEMO] [RESTRICTED] Mess Committee Review Meeting and Wi-Fi Upgrade
messages.content: The monthly hostel mess review will convene this Thursday at 19:30 hrs in the Ramanujam Hall. Wing representatives must submit student feedback on dietary requirements.

messages.title: [DEMO] Autonomous Quadruped Robot Hardware Testing
messages.content: The robotics lab is testing the ROS2 Humble navigational stack on our quadruped platform today. Anyone interested in sensor fusion with LiDAR is welcome to observe at Lab 304.

messages.title: [DEMO] High Performance Computing (HPC) Cluster Access for Research
messages.content: IT Department research students working on Deep Learning or Computer Vision projects can now request SSH credentials for the newly installed NVIDIA cluster.

replies.content: I will be there with the LiDAR point cloud visualization script on ROS2 RViz!

ideas.title: [DEMO] Edge-AI Autonomous Border Surveillance Drone
ideas.description: Developing a localized low-latency drone swarm tracking system using Jetson Orin Nano with thermal and infrared cameras for night perimeter security at rugged terrains.

ideas.title: [DEMO] Smart Campus Microgrid & Solar Energy Forecasting
ideas.description: Using transformer models to forecast AIT Pune academic block solar power generation and automatically balance hostel backup battery distribution in real time.

ideas.title: [DEMO] MediAssist: Offline Clinical Decision Support for Rural Camps
ideas.description: Quantized LLM running locally on Android tablets to help medical corps personnel triage symptoms, recommend initial treatment protocols, and catalog inventory during field drills.

ideaComments.content: Excellent problem statement. Have you considered thermal signature drift during high wind conditions?

projects.title: [DEMO] Project Garuda: Autonomous Fixed-Wing Aerial Vehicle
projects.description: Designed and fabricated by AIT students for UAV reconnaissance competitions. Features fail-safe return-to-home, 45-minute endurance, and custom carbon-composite airframe.

projects.title: [DEMO] AIT Campus Indoor Navigation & Asset Locator
projects.description: Ultra-wideband (UWB) and Bluetooth Low Energy beacons deployed across Ramanujan Block and Library for indoor pathfinding and laboratory equipment tracking.

opportunities.title: [DEMO] Cloud Systems & Distributed Storage Engineering Internship
opportunities.description: Exclusive referral and evaluation opportunity for AIT 3rd and 4th year students. Focus on high-throughput backend services, C++ / Golang, and distributed consensus.

opportunities.title: [DEMO] Autonomous Drone Flight Control Research Grant & Fellowship
opportunities.company: Defense Innovation Organization & AIT R&D Cell
opportunities.description: Funded research position to assist with obstacle avoidance algorithms on micro-drones. Hands-on testing and flight tests conducted on campus grounds.

applications.coverNote: Interested in distributed storage and consensus protocols. Built Project Garuda with ROS2/C++.
